## What this tutorial does

This document shows how to estimate an *optimum level or critical value* under model uncertainty using:

\- multiple candidate response models,

\- nonparametric bootstrap to quantify uncertainty within each model, and

\- Akaike Information Criterion (AIC) weights to average model-specific optimum estimates (AIC-WB).

The dataset and the specific optimum definition used here are only examples. The workflow is the main deliverable.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Setup

```{r}
# Core packages
library(tidyverse)
library(minpack.lm)   # nlsLM

# Data I/O
library(readxl)

```

# Data

## Load dataset

```{r}
dat <- read_excel("./case_study_AONR.xlsx", sheet = "Trial_27") |>
  dplyr::select(
    input_level = Total_N_SI,
    response    = Yield_SY
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(input_level), is.finite(response))

```


## Visual check

```{r}
ggplot(dat, aes(input_level, response)) +
  geom_point()

```

# Fit candidate models

```{r}
# Linear Plateau (LP)
fm.LP <- nlsLM(response ~ ifelse(input_level < xs,
                    a + b * input_level,
                    a + b * xs),
  data = dat,
  start = list(
    a  = unname(coef(lm(response ~ input_level, data = dat))[1]),
    b  = unname(coef(lm(response ~ input_level, data = dat))[2]),
    xs = unname(quantile(dat$input_level, 0.6, na.rm = TRUE))
  ),
  control = nls.lm.control(maxiter = 1024))

# Quadratic Plateau (QP)
fm.QP <- nlsLM(response ~ ifelse(input_level < (b1/(2*b2)),
                    b0 + b1*input_level - b2*input_level^2,
                    b0 + b1*(b1/(2*b2)) - b2*(b1/(2*b2))^2),
  data = dat,
  start = list(
    b0 = unname(coef(lm(response ~ input_level, data = dat))[1]),
    b1 = unname(coef(lm(response ~ input_level, data = dat))[2]),
    b2 = unname(abs(coef(lm(response ~ input_level, data = dat))[2]) /
                (2*unname(stats::quantile(dat$input_level, 0.6, na.rm=TRUE)) + 1e-8))
  ),
  lower = c(b0 = -Inf, b1 = -Inf, b2 = 1e-10),
  control = nls.lm.control(maxiter = 1024))

# Mitscherlich-Exponential (EXP)
fm.MIT <- nlsLM(response ~ b0 + (b1 - b0) * exp(-b2 * input_level),
  data = dat,
  start = list(
    b0 = unname(max(dat$response, na.rm = TRUE)),
    b1 = unname(min(dat$response, na.rm = TRUE)),
    b2 = 1 / unname(max(dat$input_level, na.rm = TRUE))
  ),
  lower = c(b0 = -Inf, b1 = -Inf, b2 = 1e-10),
  control = nls.lm.control(maxiter = 1024))

# Quadratic (QUA)
fm.QUA <- lm(response ~ input_level + I(input_level^2), data=dat)

```

# Compute model-specific optimum estimates

```{r}
# Model-specific thresholds
LP.est <- coef(fm.LP)[["xs"]]
QP.est <- coef(fm.QP)[["b1"]] / (2 * coef(fm.QP)[["b2"]])

b0 <- coef(fm.MIT)[["b0"]]
b1 <- coef(fm.MIT)[["b1"]]
b2 <- coef(fm.MIT)[["b2"]]
MIT.est <- if (is.finite(b0) && b0 > 0 && b0 > b1 && b2 > 0) {
  -log(0.05 * b0 / (b0 - b1)) / b2
} else NA_real_

# Center x for a numerically stable quadratic vertex
bounds <- range(dat$input_level)
xbar <- mean(dat$input_level)
xc <- dat$input_level - xbar
fit_qua <- lm(dat$response ~ xc + I(xc^2))
b1 <- coef(fit_qua)[["xc"]]
b2 <- coef(fit_qua)[["I(xc^2)"]]
QUA.est <- if (all(is.finite(c(b1, b2))) && abs(b2) >= 1e-10) {
  if (b2 > 0) {
    pred <- predict(fit_qua, newdata = data.frame(xc = bounds - xbar))
    bounds[which.max(pred)]
  } else -b1 / (2 * b2) + xbar
} else NA_real_

# Restrict point estimates to the observed nitrogen-rate range
theta <- c(LP = LP.est, QP = QP.est, MIT = MIT.est, QUA = QUA.est)
theta[!is.finite(theta)] <- NA_real_
theta <- pmin(pmax(theta, bounds[1]), bounds[2])
LP.est <- unname(theta["LP"])
QP.est <- unname(theta["QP"])
MIT.est <- unname(theta["MIT"])
QUA.est <- unname(theta["QUA"])

LP.est; QP.est; MIT.est; QUA.est
```

# Bootstrap uncertainty for each model

```{r}
set.seed(123)
R <- 5000L
n <- nrow(dat)
# Reuse the same 5,000 bootstrap samples across all four models
bootstrap_rows <- replicate(R, sample.int(n, n, replace = TRUE))

## Starts from full-data fits (more stable than re-deriving every time)
LP_start <- as.list(coef(fm.LP))
QP_start <- as.list(coef(fm.QP))
MIT_start <- as.list(coef(fm.MIT))

# LP  bootstrap: xs
LP.bt <- sapply(seq_len(R), function(i) {
  db <- dat[bootstrap_rows[, i], , drop = FALSE]

  fitb <- try(
    nlsLM(
      response ~ ifelse(input_level < xs,
                        a + b * input_level,
                        a + b * xs),
      data  = db,
      start = LP_start,
      control = nls.lm.control(maxiter = 1024)
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  if (inherits(fitb, "try-error") || !isTRUE(fitb$convInfo$isConv)) return(NA_real_)
  as.numeric(coef(fitb)[["xs"]])
})

LP.bt <- pmin(pmax(LP.bt, bounds[1]), bounds[2])
LP.ci <- quantile(LP.bt, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)

# QP bootstrap: xp = b1/(2*b2)
QP.bt <- sapply(seq_len(R), function(i) {
  db <- dat[bootstrap_rows[, i], , drop = FALSE]

  fitb <- try(
    nlsLM(
      response ~ ifelse(input_level < (b1/(2*b2)),
                        b0 + b1*input_level - b2*input_level^2,
                        b0 + b1*(b1/(2*b2)) - b2*(b1/(2*b2))^2),
      data  = db,
      start = QP_start,
      lower = c(b0 = -Inf, b1 = -Inf, b2 = 1e-10),
      control = nls.lm.control(maxiter = 1024)
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  if (inherits(fitb, "try-error") || !isTRUE(fitb$convInfo$isConv)) return(NA_real_)

  cf <- coef(fitb)
  b1 <- as.numeric(cf[["b1"]])
  b2 <- as.numeric(cf[["b2"]])

  if (!is.finite(b1) || !is.finite(b2) || b2 <= 0) return(NA_real_)

  xp <- b1 / (2 * b2)
  if (!is.finite(xp)) return(NA_real_)

  xp
})

QP.bt <- pmin(pmax(QP.bt, bounds[1]), bounds[2])
QP.ci <- quantile(QP.bt, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)

# MIT bootstrap: x at targ% of plateau
MIT.bt <- sapply(seq_len(R), function(i) {
  db <- dat[bootstrap_rows[, i], , drop = FALSE]

  fitb <- try(
    nlsLM(
      response ~ b0 + (b1 - b0) * exp(-b2 * input_level),
      data  = db,
      start = MIT_start,
      lower = c(b0 = -Inf, b1 = -Inf, b2 = 1e-10),
      control = nls.lm.control(maxiter = 1024)
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  if (inherits(fitb, "try-error") || !isTRUE(fitb$convInfo$isConv)) return(NA_real_)

  cf <- coef(fitb)
  b0 <- as.numeric(cf[["b0"]])
  b1 <- as.numeric(cf[["b1"]])
  b2 <- as.numeric(cf[["b2"]])

  if (!all(is.finite(c(b0, b1, b2))) || b0 <= 0 || b2 <= 0 || b0 <= b1) return(NA_real_)

  -log((1 - 0.95) * b0 / (b0 - b1)) / b2
})

MIT.bt <- pmin(pmax(MIT.bt, bounds[1]), bounds[2])
MIT.ci <- quantile(MIT.bt, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)

# QUA bootstrap: centered quadratic vertex
QUA.bt <- sapply(seq_len(R), function(i) {
  db <- dat[bootstrap_rows[, i], , drop = FALSE]
  xbar <- mean(db$input_level)
  xc <- db$input_level - xbar
  fitb <- try(lm(db$response ~ xc + I(xc^2)), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(fitb, "try-error")) return(NA_real_)

  b1 <- coef(fitb)[["xc"]]
  b2 <- coef(fitb)[["I(xc^2)"]]
  if (!all(is.finite(c(b1, b2))) || abs(b2) < 1e-10)
    return(NA_real_)

  if (b2 > 0) {
    pred <- predict(fitb, newdata = data.frame(xc = bounds - xbar))
    return(bounds[which.max(pred)])
  }
  -b1 / (2 * b2) + xbar
})
QUA.bt <- pmin(pmax(QUA.bt, bounds[1]), bounds[2])
QUA.ci <- quantile(QUA.bt, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)

# Results
tibble(
  Model    = c("LP","QP","MIT","QUA"),
  Estimate = c(LP.est, QP.est, MIT.est, QUA.est),
  CI_2.5   = c(LP.ci[1], QP.ci[1], MIT.ci[1], QUA.ci[1]),
  CI_97.5  = c(LP.ci[2], QP.ci[2], MIT.ci[2], QUA.ci[2])
)

```

# AIC weights and AIC-WB optimum distribution

## Compute AIC weights

```{r}
AICs <- c(
  LP  = AIC(fm.LP),
  QP  = AIC(fm.QP),
  MIT = AIC(fm.MIT),
  QUA = AIC(fm.QUA)
)

# Models with invalid point estimates receive zero weight
AICs[!is.finite(theta)] <- Inf
valid <- is.finite(AICs)
if (!any(valid)) stop("No valid models for AIC-WB.")
dAIC <- AICs[valid] - min(AICs[valid])
w <- setNames(numeric(length(AICs)), names(AICs))
w[valid] <- exp(-0.5 * dAIC) / sum(exp(-0.5 * dAIC))
w
```

## AIC-WB point estimate and CI

```{r}
# Weights from the original data remain fixed across bootstrap replicates
valid <- is.finite(theta) & w > 0
theta_aic_hat <- weighted.mean(theta[valid], w[valid])

bootstrap_theta <- cbind(LP = LP.bt, QP = QP.bt,
                         MIT = MIT.bt, QUA = QUA.bt)

# If a fit fails in a replicate, renormalize weights over valid models
theta_aic_bt <- apply(bootstrap_theta, 1, function(x) {
  valid <- is.finite(x) & w > 0
  if (!any(valid)) return(NA_real_)
  weighted.mean(x[valid], w[valid])
})

theta_aic_ci <- quantile(theta_aic_bt, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
theta_aic_hat
theta_aic_ci
```

# Visualization

## AIC-WB bootstrap distribution

```{r}
ci <- theta_aic_ci
theta_ci <- theta_aic_bt[theta_aic_bt >= ci[1] & theta_aic_bt <= ci[2]]

hist(theta_ci,
     breaks = 30,
     main   = "AIC-weighted bootstrap distribution (95% CI)",
     xlab   = "AIC-WB theta estimate")

```

## Model-specific bootstrap distributions

```{r, warning=FALSE}
df_aic_bt <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  tibble(model = "LP",  theta = LP.bt),
  tibble(model = "QP",  theta = QP.bt),
  tibble(model = "MIT", theta = MIT.bt),
  tibble(model = "QUA", theta = QUA.bt)
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(theta))

Fig_aic_hist <- ggplot(df_aic_bt, aes(x = theta)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, color = "black", fill = "gray80") +
  facet_wrap(~ model, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 350), breaks = seq(0, 350, 50)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  labs(
    x = "Estimate theta",
    y = "Frequency"
  )

Fig_aic_hist

```

## Final figure (data + candidate fits + AIC-WB)

```{r , fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
new.input_levels <- data.frame(input_level = 0:320)

prds.LP  <- predict(fm.LP,  new.input_levels)
prds.QP  <- predict(fm.QP,  new.input_levels)
prds.MIT <- predict(fm.MIT, new.input_levels)
prds.QUA <- predict(fm.QUA, new.input_levels)

opt_points <- tibble(
  model = c("LP", "QP", "MIT", "QUA"),
  x_opt = c(LP.est, QP.est, MIT.est, QUA.est),
  y_opt = c(
    predict(fm.LP,  newdata = data.frame(input_level = LP.est)),
    predict(fm.QP,  newdata = data.frame(input_level = QP.est)),
    predict(fm.MIT, newdata = data.frame(input_level = MIT.est)),
    predict(fm.QUA, newdata = data.frame(input_level = QUA.est))
  )
)

Fig_AIC <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = dat, aes(input_level, response),
             alpha = 0.8, size = 1.5) +

  geom_line(aes(x = new.input_levels$input_level, y = prds.LP,  linetype = "LP")) +
  geom_line(aes(x = new.input_levels$input_level, y = prds.QP,  linetype = "QP")) +
  geom_line(aes(x = new.input_levels$input_level, y = prds.MIT, linetype = "MIT")) +
  geom_line(aes(x = new.input_levels$input_level, y = prds.QUA, linetype = "QUA")) +

  geom_point(data = opt_points,
             aes(x = x_opt, y = y_opt, shape = model),
             size = 2.5, fill = "gray", stroke = 1.1) +

  geom_point(aes(x = theta_aic_hat, y = 3000, color = "AIC-WB"),
             size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(y = 3000,
                    xmin = theta_aic_ci[1],
                    xmax = theta_aic_ci[2],
                    color = "AIC-WB"),
                width = 0) +

  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 350), breaks = seq(0, 350, 50)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 14000), breaks = seq(0, 14000, 2000)) +

  scale_shape_manual(values = c(LP = 21, QP = 22, MIT = 24, QUA = 23)) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(LP = "solid",
                                   QP = "dotted",
                                   MIT = "longdash",
                                   QUA = "dotdash")) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c("AIC-WB" = "black")) +

  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +

  labs(
    x = expression(Nitrogen~rate~(kg~ha^-1)),
    y = expression(Grain~yield~(kg~ha^-1)),
    linetype = "Response model",
    shape    = "Response model",
    color    = "Averaging method"
  )

Fig_AIC

```
